document.title: Dec 6, 2025 BlueTech Business + Beginner Class Raw Transcript Extraction

students.name: Tiên Truong
students.observations: 'I don't know' breakthrough #2 — said it immediately without freezing when asked about 'distracted'. Genre vocabulary learned (horror fan confirmed). Improving rapidly between sessions.

students.name: Nga Lương
students.observations: Wedding Dec 20, 2025. Fiancé: hardworking + kind. Plans: 1 boy + 1 girl. Finance dept. Lock screen = wedding photo.

students.name: Linh Lê Trúc
students.observations: 'Uh' filler habit still severe — multiple corrections this session. 3-week build / 3-month destroy timeline established. Self-observation method reinforced.

students.name: Huong Ho
students.observations: Very busy week: 2 fashion workshops + 1 Peace Canada event. Leader/letter/leather phonics confusion demonstrated perfectly why phonics matter. Translated throughout.

students.name: Denny Nguyen
students.observations: ABC practice (eyes-closed challenge). Quick mimicry. H/Z/G confusion. Translator helper role for Ling.

students.name: Entertainment UL / Ling
students.observations: NEW STUDENT. Streaming business owner. Former model age 18-22 (~age 30 now). Home studio with 2 rooms. 40 models coming for photo shoot next day. Professional singer. No camera. 8-year business.

teaching_methods.name: Just the Wind
teaching_methods.description: Humorous English-only enforcement — 'That was just the wind, right? Not Vietnamese?'

teaching_methods.name: I Don't Know Celebration #2
teaching_methods.description: Second celebration of Tiên saying 'I don't know' without freezing — reinforces breakthrough habit

teaching_methods.name: Genre Vocabulary
teaching_methods.description: Teaching 'genre' as French-origin English word — pronunciation vs spelling disconnect

teaching_methods.name: Jump Scare Teaching
teaching_methods.description: Using horror movie concept to teach vocabulary through emotional connection and humor

teaching_methods.name: Filler Word Correction
teaching_methods.description: Continued 'uh' elimination for Linh — '3 weeks to build, 3 months to destroy' timeline

teaching_methods.name: Self-Observation
teaching_methods.description: 'Watch yourself speak — become your own teacher' — reinforced from Nov 8

teaching_methods.name: Live Lesson Generation
teaching_methods.description: Built full lesson ('Why humans can't lick their elbow') in real-time using AI pipeline while teaching
teaching_methods.demo_output: 6-slide lesson, built at student level, funny + educational, no corrections needed

teaching_methods.name: AI-Generated Reading Script
teaching_methods.description: Created personalized reading script for Ling about her streaming business using AI

teaching_methods.name: ABC/Phonics Foundation
teaching_methods.description: Full alphabet practice with reading, eyes-closed challenge, and repetition

teaching_methods.name: H Sound Secret
teaching_methods.description: H = number 'eight' + 'ch' sound from cheese — Vietnamese say 'hatch' but English H is different

teaching_methods.name: Q/Z/X Sound Secrets
teaching_methods.description: Q = memorize (not 'qu'), Z = zebra (not G), X = K + S sound (like cake)

teaching_methods.name: 44 Phonics Introduction
teaching_methods.description: 26 letters but 44 sounds — phonics ≠ alphabet — T in 'thank' sounds different than letter T

teaching_methods.name: Habit Building Timeline
teaching_methods.description: '3 weeks to build a habit, 3 months to destroy a bad one' — sets expectations

teaching_methods.name: I Say Something You Say Something
teaching_methods.description: Communication rule: teacher speaks → student responds. No silence. Builds conversation reflex.

teaching_methods.name: Denny as Translator Helper
teaching_methods.description: Assign stronger beginner as real-time translator for weaker beginner — both practice

teaching_methods.name: 12-Week Program Structure
teaching_methods.description: Week 1: AI basics. Week 2: Email/meetings. Week 7: Presentations. Tests every 4 weeks. Final exam.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: 1 p.m. starts until 2:30. No Vietnamese. You think in English, you dream in English, you eat in English. Everything English for 90 minutes.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: Miss Tien didn't even freeze at all. She just said 'I don't know.' Yay! I want to have a party. That's how excited I am.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: It takes three weeks to build. It will be very difficult at the beginning... then after this 3-month program, that habit will be completely destroyed.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: If you listen to yourself speak and watch yourself speak, you become your own teacher.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: Gemini is the architect... GPT is the builder... Perplexity is the inspector... Claude makes the final product.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.context: after leader/letter/leather confusion with Huong Ho

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: Because you're a beginner, it'll be easy for me to help you have good habits at the beginning.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: There are 44 phonic sounds in English... the next three months we will study a lot on phonics.

verbatim_quotes.speaker: Michael
verbatim_quotes.text: I say something, you say something. Not: I say something, you [silence].
